metaPrompt.label: Meta Prompt
metaPrompt.description: Generate new prompts from raw user ideas
metaPrompt.thinkingPattern: AI doesn't answer the task directly, but writes a prompt to answer that task

selfRefine.label: Self-Refine
selfRefine.thinkingPattern: AI reads the old prompt and writes a new, more effective version

chainOfThought.label: Chain-of-Thought
chainOfThought.description: Break down how the model reasons about the prompt
chainOfThought.thinkingPattern: AI writes thinking steps before providing the final answer

selfConsistency.label: Self-Consistency
selfConsistency.description: Test prompt stability with multiple reasoning
selfConsistency.thinkingPattern: AI generates multiple reasoning paths and selects the most consistent one

chainOfPrompt.label: Chain-of-Prompt
chainOfPrompt.thinkingPattern: Each version is an improvement from the previous version

rolePrompt.label: Role Prompt
rolePrompt.description: Discuss or evaluate prompts with a specific persona
rolePrompt.thinkingPattern: AI speaks as a persona: Reviewer, Editor, Developer, or Researcher
